别开闸！我们就是喝了上游的水，才带着孩子逃到这里。: Do not open the gate! We fled here with our children after drinking the water upstream.
艾琳把干净的水分给我们，自己守了两夜。她说，下游还有很多人家。: Erin gave us her clean water. She has kept watch for two nights. She says there are families downstream, too.
村里的井都干了。这道闸……是你封上的？: Our wells are dry. This gate... did you close it?
是我。你可以怪我，但先看看闸外的水，还有桥边那些人。我不能让黑雾沿水流进村子。: I did. But look at the water beyond it, and speak to the people by the bridge. I cannot let the black mist reach your village.
核心还在。残余的黑雾正聚过来，帮我守住泉眼，我来净化。: The core is intact. More black mist is gathering. Guard the spring while I cleanse it.
等一下……我刚才说不怕，其实腿一直在抖。: Wait... I said I was not scared, but my legs were shaking.
害怕也可以。抓住我的袖子，我们一起走。: It is all right to be scared. Hold my sleeve. We will walk together.
水壶没有摔坏。等河水回来了，我就不用再跑这么远了。: My flask is still in one piece. When the river returns, I will not have to come so far for water.
黑色沉淀散开了。来，把闸门打开。: The black sediment is clearing. Open the gate.
我在这里等你吧。他们若知道是我封的闸……: I should wait here. If they find out I closed the gate...
你保护了他们，也让他们等了很久。一起回去，把经过告诉大家。: You protected them, but they have waited a long time. Come back with me and tell them what happened.
……好。这次我不躲在闸门后面。: ...All right. No more hiding behind the gate.
还没走到家门口，你先听见了木轮转动的声音。村民提着水桶走出屋子，久违的水声重新响: Before you reach home, you hear the waterwheel turning. Villagers emerge with buckets as water flows through Morningwind once more.
是你们！妈妈，水真的回来了！: You are back! Mum, the water really came back!

小诺还被蝙蝠困着: The bat is keeping Noah trapped.
我没想乱跑……昨夜来的骑士一直发烧，妈妈把最后半壶水留给了他。: I did not mean to wander off... The knight had a fever all night. Mum gave him the last of our water.
所以你想去上游找水？你能走吗？: So you went upstream to find more? Can you walk?
能走。只是水壶还是空的……妈妈和伤员都在等水。: Yes. But my flask is still empty... Mum and the knight are waiting.
我在林子里看见黑雾贴着河底，往上游爬。水却一滴也没有。: I saw black mist crawling upstream along the riverbed. But there was no water at all.
先带你回家。找水的事交给我，别再一个人跑进林子里。: Let us get you home first. I will find water. No more going into the woods alone.
等等小诺，带他一起回来。: Wait for Noah. Bring him back with you.
小诺！水没了，我们还能再找……你要是回不来，我该怎么办？: Noah! We can always find more water... What would I do if you never came home?
对不起，妈妈。我只是不想让那位叔叔死掉。: I am sorry, Mum. I just did not want that man to die.
是我把危险带到了这里。那些骸骨兵一直追着护送队的旗号。: I brought this danger here. Those skeletons have been following our convoy's banner.
现在不是追究这个的时候。把村民带进屋，我去守路口。: We can talk about that later. Get everyone indoors. I will hold the entrance.
我还能握剑。你守住水渠这边，孩子们交给我！: I can still hold a sword. Cover the canal. I will protect the children!
水回来了！可这些天，到底出了什么事？: The water is back! But what happened up there?
妈妈，我把水壶装满了！这次我留在村里帮你。: Mum, I filled the flask! This time I will stay and help you.
是我封了闸，才没让黑水流下来。对不起，消息没能及时送到。: I closed the gate to stop the tainted water. I am sorry I could not get word to you sooner.
先坐下，慢慢说。第一桶水已经送给伤员了，灶上也给你们留了饭。: Sit down and tell us. The wounded have their water, and there is food for both of you.
谢谢。艾琳，今天多亏有你。等行囊备好，我们就出发吧。: Thank you. Erin, I could not have done this alone. Once our bags are ready, let us set out.
好。我带路，我们一起去找救公主的办法。: All right. I will lead the way. Together, we will find a way to help the princess.
河水重新流过晨风村。主角决定与艾琳同行，从旧矿洞寻找通往北境的路。: Water flows through Morningwind again. The hero and Erin will travel together, seeking a northern passage through the old mine.
小诺往村东去了，拜托你找找他。: Noah went east of the village. Please find him.
多亏有你。村子会一直等你平安回来。: Thank you. We will be here, waiting for your safe return.
刚才多亏你守住了村口。我是罗兰，王城护卫。: Thank you for holding the entrance. I am Roland, a royal guard.
那些魔物为什么一直追着你们？王城出什么事了？: Why were those monsters following you? What happened at the capital?
魔王袭击了护送队，掳走了莉娅公主。我带着村民逃出来，却没能把她带回来。: The Demon King attacked our convoy and took Princess Lia. I got the villagers out, but I could not save her.
就是命人修水渠的那位公主？她现在在哪里？: The princess who had our canals built? Where is she now?
北境的城堡。我追过一次，连山口都没能过去。如今这副样子，走远路都撑不住。: A castle in the north. I tried to follow, but could not reach the pass. With these wounds, I can barely travel.
那还有谁能去救她？: Then who can go after her?
我已经托人送信求援，可王城一直没有回音。我怕她等不了那么久。: I sent for help, but the capital has not answered. I fear she cannot wait much longer.
……我也不知道能不能闯进那座城堡。但总不能让她一直等着。去北境，该走哪条路？: ...I do not know if I can reach that castle. But we cannot just leave her waiting. Which way is north?
你想去？刚才那些骸骨兵，还只是最弱的一批。: You want to go? Those skeletons were the weakest of them.
我知道。先找到路，再想办法救人。你留下照顾村民，我去找个熟悉北境的人问问。: I know. First I need a road, then a plan. Stay and help the village. I will find someone who knows the north.
泉岛的艾琳认识那边的路。带上我的徽记，她会帮你。答应我，别一个人硬闯。: Erin on Spring Isle knows the roads. Take my badge; she will help you. Promise me you will not rush in alone.
好，我先去找她。通往泉岛的桥还能走吗？: I will find her first. Can I still cross the bridge to the island?
桥锁住了。北林和石场各有一枚河印，集齐就能打开。路上小心。: It is locked. There is a river seal in Northwood and another in the quarry. Together they open it. Take care.
伤口还没合上，但守村不只靠挥剑。我会教大家架路障，给晚归的人留灯。: My wounds are still healing, but a sword is not the only way to help. I will build barricades and keep a light for late travelers.
渠水已经到了村口。我会把路修好，等你们带着公主回来。: The water has reached us. I will mend the road while you are away.
两处导流机关都被人反向拧紧了。这里的水不会自己倒流。: Someone forced both sluices into reverse. Water does not turn back on its own.
我追到石场，发现搬运队留下的黑铁碎片。巡林人的刀可凿不出那种刻痕。: I tracked them to the quarry and found black iron shards. A ranger's blade could never leave marks like those.

先把小诺带回村，听取骑士的消息。: Bring Noah home and speak to the knight first.

黑雾在沿旧河道寻找入口。它们不是为了抢走村里的水。: The mist is using the old riverbed to get in. This was never just about stealing our water.
运单上的王印与河印吻合。这些净水石真是莉娅送来的。: The royal stamp matches the seal. These cleansing stones really were sent by Princess Lia.

她明知道车队有危险，还是把这些石头留给了我们。: She knew the convoy was in danger, and still left these supplies for us.
两枚河印回应了。桥已打开——得赶在黑雾之前找到艾琳。: Both seals are responding. The bridge is open. I need to reach Erin before the mist does.
拿到一枚了。再找到另一枚，就能打开河桥。: One seal found. One more to open the bridge.
罗兰让我把徽记交给你。他留在村里养伤，说你知道去北境的路。: Roland asked me to give you his badge. He is recovering in the village. He says you know the northern roads.
他还活着……太好了。你是想去救公主？: He is alive... Thank goodness. Are you hoping to rescue the princess?
嗯，想先向你问问路。不过我看过闸外的黑水了，得先解决村里的断水。: Yes. I came to ask the way. But I saw the black water beyond the gate. We need to help the village first.

击碎外层的黑色结晶，留下核心，我就能净化泉水。: Break the black crystals on its shell. Leave the core intact, and I can cleanse the water.
只打外面的结晶……我试试。你帮我看着核心。: Only the outer crystals... I will try. Keep an eye on the core for me.
好，我在这里接应你。: I will be here to help.
先把伤处理好。泉眼的封印已经松动，别放弃。: Let me tend your wounds. The seal is weakening. Keep going.
泉水已经恢复。回村告诉大家吧，之后我们一起去旧矿洞。: The water is clear. Let us tell the village, then prepare for the old mine.
黑色沉淀散了，可以开闸了。: The sediment is gone. We can open the gate.
终于流下去了。村里的人不用再到处找水了。: It is flowing again. No more searching everywhere for water.

那就先去看看矿洞。艾琳，你愿意带路吗？: Then let us start with the mine. Erin, will you show me the way?
愿意。先回村报平安，再备些药和灯。: I will. First, tell the village we are safe. Then pack medicine and a lantern.
先与艾琳会合，解除石像守卫的侵蚀。: Meet Erin and defeat the tainted guardian first.

水车停转的第三天，晨风村最后一口井也见了底。昨夜，村民又抬回来一位负伤的王城骑士: Three days after the waterwheel stopped, Morningwind's last well ran dry. Last night, villagers carried in a wounded royal knight.

那孩子一定是去找水了。求你带他回来，别让他再往黑雾里走。: He must be looking for water. Please bring him home before he reaches that black mist.
我去找他。您先把门灯留着，让他回来的时候一眼就能看见家。: I will find him. Leave the lantern by the door, so he can see his way home.
村口守住了。那些东西没有搜粮食，一直想绕向河道……: The entrance is safe. Those creatures ignored our food. They kept trying to reach the river...
小诺也看见黑雾在河底移动。袭击和断水不是两件事。: Noah saw mist moving along the riverbed, too. The attack and the missing water are connected.
你该知道全部经过。等我替孩子们关好门，到营火边来找我。: You should hear the whole story. Once the children are safe inside, meet me by the campfire.
停下了……它在把身体转向泉眼。: It stopped... It is turning toward the spring.
护送平民……封住黑雾……命令者：莉娅。: Escort civilians... Seal away the mist... By order of Princess Lia.
这才是它最后接到的命令。莉娅让它守护难民，魔王却把这份命令扭曲成了牢笼。: Its last order. Lia told it to protect the refugees. The Demon King twisted that duty into a prison.
我们把它解开了。现在，让河水回家。: We have set it free. Now let us bring the water home.

脚印旁还有水壶留下的圆印。小诺应该往这边去了。: Round marks from a flask beside them. Noah must have gone this way.
水车重新转起来了。村里终于又有干净的水了。: The wheel is turning again. At last, the village has clean water.
石头上全是朝同一方向的凿痕，缝里卡着黑铁屑。有人把水闸反向锁死了。: Every chisel mark runs the same way. Black iron shards are caught in the cracks. Someone forced the sluice shut.
黑铁屑碰到水汽就冒出黑烟。得把这件事告诉艾琳。: The iron gives off black smoke when it gets wet. Erin needs to hear about this.
奉莉娅殿下令：净水石不随车队撤离，优先送往下游村庄。护送人：罗兰。: By order of Princess Lia: leave the cleansing stones for the downstream villages. Escort: Roland.
这批物资原本是送往村里的。先把河闸修好，村民就有救了。: These supplies were meant for our village. If we restore the sluices, we can help everyone.

林边刻痕：黑铁工具逆转了水闸，水汽会激起碎屑中的黑雾。: Woodland marks: black iron tools reversed the sluice. The shards release black mist when wet.
